The brief

Give each sample product a clear role and a consistent information order. The pack artwork is visibly illustrated, rather than presented as product photography.

The layout approach

A beauty catalog study pairing floral photography with flat packaging illustrations.

  • Editable vector packaging illustrations
  • Product names, sample sizes and prices in a stable hierarchy
  • A collection index and botanical detail crops
